title: Endpoint Quickstart: Voice & Tone Playbook
body:
Goal: Consolidate voice, tone, and microcopy guidelines for the Endpoint Quickstart flows so copy remains consistent across catalog, pin, and create-endpoint experiences. This doc is a playbook + pragmatic copy drop-in for wireframes and sprint grooming (not final legal/marketing copy).

Context and scope:
- Primary flow: user lands on model catalog -> chooses model -> quick-create endpoint (compact flow) -> optionally pin model version -> reach endpoint details page.
- Secondary flows covered: error states (model not compatible), fallback pin flow, canary toggle microcopy, rollback/undo affordances.
- Audience: software engineers building the console, PMs shipping the quickstart, content designers and solutions engineers.

Tone guidelines (brief):
- Helpful and direct: assume engineers want to move fast; provide short, actionable lines.
- Avoid hype: factual status, explicit tradeoffs (latency vs cost).
- Reassuring on defaults: default config should be framed as "recommended for most workloads".
- Accessibility-first: short labels, visible state, avoid color-only signals.

Primary microcopy buckets (wireframe-ready variants):
1) Catalog card CTA (compact):
   - Primary CTA: "Create endpoint" (preferred)
   - Secondary w/ microcopy: "Create endpoint — recommended" (for curated models)
   - Tooltip: "Reserve capacity and expose a stable URL for production requests."

2) Quick-create modal header / stepper: 
   - Header: "Create endpoint"
   - Subtitle: "Pick a model, confirm a name, and deploy in seconds."
   - Stepper labels: "Model" / "Plan & Capacity" / "Pin & Deploy"

3) Model selection row copy:
   - Display name: "LlamaX 13B (fp16)"
   - Version line: "v2026-01-12 — optimized for low-latency"
   - Compatibility badge copy: "Compatible with quick-create" / "Requires dedicated capacity"
   - Tooltip for compatibility badge: "This model’s memory profile exceeds the maximum for the free quick-create pool; choose Dedicated or use smaller sequence lengths."

4) Pin dialog (microcopy variations):
   - Title: "Pin a model version to this endpoint"
   - Body variant A (clear/explicit): "Pinning locks this endpoint to a specific model version. Future updates will not change generated outputs unless you unpin or update the pin."
   - Body variant B (concise): "Lock to a model version to guarantee consistent outputs."
   - Confirm button: "Pin version and deploy"
   - Secondary button: "Skip pin (use latest)"
   - Tooltip when hovering 'Skip pin': "Choosing latest will automatically pick the newest compatible version; outputs may vary over time."
   - Inline hint: "Recommended for production: pin a version. For experiments: skip pin to test latest improvements."

5) Confirmation toast and undo: 
   - Success toast: "Endpoint created — URL copied to clipboard."
   - Action in toast: "Undo pin" (this shows for 20s after pin)
   - Undo modal microcopy: "Revert to previous pin? This will restore the endpoint to its prior model version."

6) Error states (short, debug-friendly):
   - Model incompatible: "Couldn’t create endpoint: model requires dedicated capacity (memory: 96GB)."
   - Version missing: "Pinned version not found. The pinned model version may have been removed."
   - Conflict on name: "Endpoint name already in use — choose a different name or append a suffix."

7) Fallback copy when capacity constrained: 
   - Top-level banner: "We’re routing requests to a compatible lower-cost variant to keep your endpoint online."
   - Tooltip: "You can pin to the original variant to wait for capacity or accept this fallback for better availability."

8) Canary / rollout microcopy (A/B and automatic fallback):
   - Canary label: "Canary: 10% traffic"
   - Canary hint: "Gradually test a new version on a small portion of traffic. Redwood will auto-failover if latency or error rate spikes."

Accessibility / UI hints for engineers: 
- Provide explicit aria-labels for CTAs: e.g., aria-label="Create endpoint for LlamaX 13B".
- When showing pin state, include text "Pinned to v2026-01-12" adjacent to the icon, not only as tooltip.
- Error modals must include role="alertdialog" and a clear link to logs: "View deploy logs"
- Keyboard focus order: Model list -> Selected model details -> Name input -> Plan selector -> Pin toggle -> Create button.

Wireframe writeups (component-level):
- Quick-create compact: single-column modal with sticky footer. Left: model list (compact cards). Right: selected model details (name, tags, versions dropdown). Middle-bottom: "Pin?" toggle with microcopy and link "What does pinning do?".
- Full-step quickstart: top stepper, larger guidance copy, explicit capacity sliders (dev vs production). Include affordance for "preview payload" which runs a 1-token smoke request.

Copy variants to A/B test (small, testable differences):
- Create CTA A: "Create endpoint" vs B: "Create endpoint — recommended"
- Pin confirm A: "Pin version and deploy" vs B: "Lock version" (test for clarity and conversion)
- Fallback banner A: "Routed to compatible variant" vs B: "Using alternative variant to maintain availability"

Backlog grooming notes (prioritized, with rough estimates):
- P1: Add visible pin label to endpoint list rows (not only in details) — 1d — owner: frontend-ux
- P1: Implement undo for pin changes (20s toast + revert API) — 2d — owner: platform-backend
- P2: Add compatibility badge tooltip content based on memory footprint — 1d — owner: infra-aware-runtime
- P2: Expose "preview payload" in quick-create (1 small sample request) — 2d — owner: serving-runtime + api
- P3: Localize microcopy for fr/ja/es (initial set) — 3d — owner: content-internationalization
- P3: Accessibility audit on quick-create flow (keyboard + screen reader) — 2d — owner: eng-sre/accessibility

Open questions & decisions to make in grooming: 
- Default for quick-create pin: should we default to pin OR default to latest? (Recommendation: default to latest for low-friction, but show strong inline recommended language to pin for production.)
- Should 'Skip pin' be visually demoted? (Yes — secondary action style + explanatory tooltip.)
- How many fallback variants do we expose to users? Minimal UX: show single "compatible fallback" with link to view alternatives.

Implementation notes for engineers: 
- API side: accept optional pin_version field on endpoint.create; if present, persist and expose pin_only boolean distinct from auto-rolling.
- Frontend: keep copy strings in single locale file (endpoint_quickstart.json) to avoid duplication across components.
- Telemetry: track events: quickcreate_initiated, pin_selected, pin_skipped, create_success, preview_request_success. Add a pin_undo metric.

QA checklist for release: 
- [ ] Create endpoint with pin + verify pinned model in response headers.
- [ ] Create endpoint without pin and trigger new model deploy -> observe response differences.
- [ ] Attempt quick-create with incompatible model -> verify error copy and suggested action.
- [ ] Trigger capacity fallback and confirm banner copy + link behavior.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation passes (tab order matches accessibility notes).

Appendix: Short copy snippets for engineers (copy-drop list):
- Primary CTA: "Create endpoint"
- Pin dialog title: "Pin a model version to this endpoint"
- Pin dialog confirm: "Pin version and deploy"
- Skip pin: "Skip pin (use latest)"
- Success toast: "Endpoint created — URL copied to clipboard."
- Fallback banner: "Routed to a compatible variant to preserve availability."
- Error memory: "Requires dedicated capacity (memory: 96GB)."

Notes to reviewers:
- Please comment inline with preferred variants and if you think defaults should change based on customer feedback (cc: Ravi/Sofie).
- If we proceed, I’ll convert this into a short annotated Figma page and attach exact strings to the i18n file.

References:
- Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PC/Endpoint+Quickstart+Spec
- JIRA epic: RINF-2147
- Related wireframes: /design/console/quick-create/frames-v3 (Figma)

Draft history: 
- 2026-01-08 Marina Chen: initial draft
- 2026-02-14 Ravi Kapoor: added accessibility notes and QA checklist
- 2026-03-10 Sofie Martin: cleaned copy variants and added backlog priorities

Last action items (for next grooming):
- Decide default pin behavior (owner: PM)
- Add telemetry events to backlog ticket RINF-2156 (owner: platform-analytics)
- Create small figma page with annotated copy locations (owner: design)
summary: Playbook for voice/tone and copy variants for the endpoint quickstart flow. Includes copy-drop snippets, wireframe component notes, accessibility guidance, A/B variants, and a prioritized backlog with rough estimates.
